note: Hand-written expectations for F-002. maxCharsPerLine and maxLinesPerPage are deliberately arbitrary here: the real values are screen measurements each platform makes for itself, and are NOT part of the shared rule. What is shared is that no word is ever lost.

cases.name: plain wrap
cases.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
cases.why: greedy wrap; 3 lines over a 2-line page means 2 pages, not a cut

cases.name: word exactly fills the line
cases.why: a word of exactly maxChars fits and must not hard-break

cases.name: single word longer than the line hard-breaks
cases.why: every character still shown, spread over more lines. This is NOT omission — truncating to 'Supercalif…' would be

cases.name: long word mid-sentence
cases.why: the in-progress line is flushed before the oversized word breaks

cases.name: empty cue
cases.why: never returns an empty list; callers can index [0] unconditionally

cases.name: collapses runs of whitespace
cases.why: wrapping is over words; the cue's own line breaks are not honoured

cases.name: three full pages
cases.text: a b c d e f g h i j k l
cases.why: pagination is a plain chunk; the last page is not padded
